pages.title: Enemy Yari
pages.text: Yari-type monsters. Yari-type monsters have fast attack speed, fast movement speed, and high damage. They deal true damage that can only be blocked by Resistance by up to 50%. Spawn frequency is relatively low.

pages.name: Enemy Yari
pages.text: The basic yari unit of the Retrograde Army. Average in size, with relatively fast attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Yari
pages.text: A specialized enemy yari with further increased attack power and movement speed, posing a significantly greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Yari / High-Speed Yari
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy yari, also known as the High-Speed Yari. They possess even higher attack speed, movement speed, and higher true damage. An extremely high threat.
